'''Riselle''' is one of [[Tylin|Tylin's]] attendants.{{ref/book|7|31}}

== Appearance ==
She has a "spectacular"{{ref/book|7|29}}, "marvelous"{{ref/book|7|39}} bosom.

== Activities ==
She meets [[Matrim Cauthon]] while he is staying at the [[Tarasin Palace]]. [[Tylin Quintara Mitsobar|Queen Tylin]] moves Riselle into Mat's rooms as [[Olver]]'s caretaker, forcing Mat to move into Tylin's chambers instead. 

Riselle develops a mother-son relationship with Olver and begins to read to him most nights. While this happens he snuggles up into her bosom. According to [[Thomdril Merrilin|Thom Merrilin]], she also lets the [[gleeman]] rest his head on her bosom, though he must play his harp for her first. Riselle also takes Olver to the [[Festival of Birds]]. 

On the day of the [[Seanchan]] invasion of Ebou Dar, Riselle had let Olver explore the city, forcing Mat and the [[Band of the Red Hand]] to stay in the city to search for Olver. This led to Mat and the Band being trapped in Seanchan following the occupation.   

Following the invasion, Riselle meets and takes an attraction to Seanchan Banner-General [[Efraim Yamada]] and his singing voice. While Mat plans the escape from occupied Ebou Dar, Thom uses her relationship with Yamada to get information on Seanchan security. However, Thom ceases this when he learns that Riselle intends to marry Yamada. Yamada buys her a vineyard in the [[Rhannon Hills]] as a wedding gift and they marry soon afterwards.[[Category:The Blood]]
